missions.title: Clearing a Path
missions.description: The commander's performance so far has been acknowledged by HQ. We've been ordered to press ahead and recover all lost territories in Area S09.

missions.title: Intercepted Intelligence
missions.description: As we move, M4A1 has been contacting other members of the AR Team, from whom she was separated during a certain mission.

missions.title: Covert Reinforcement
missions.description: The commander successfully recovered SOP-II from the AR Team, but learned that AR-15, who had stayed behind to bring up the rear, was still missing.

missions.title: Defensive Operation
missions.description: The Command Post was ambushed. We managed to return just in time to defend it thanks to intelligence provided by SOP-II.

missions.title: Swift Counterattack
missions.description: HQ ordered us to search for the local Sangvis Ringleader's base. It's pretty eyecatching, all right, but we just can't get in...

missions.title: No Hunting
missions.description: Hunter's base fell into disarray all of a sudden, then AR-15 emerged from within, covered in injuries. What on earth happened in there...?

missions.title: Data Retrieval I
missions.description: I applied for this mission without consulting the commander, but the commander still decided to accept the challenge even though it was much harder than I expected. All the best!

missions.title: Data Retrieval II
missions.description: We have recovered a few military hard disks but can't read the content... I'm dying to know what's inside...

missions.title: Data Retrieval III
missions.description: Sangvis forces came after the hard disks, which means they're a big deal to them. They must contain some kind of important data!

missions.title: Data Retrieval IV
missions.description: The commander listened to some of the recordings on the hard disks after the mission and looked a bit grave... Does S.F. still have many aces up their sleeve?

missions.title: Anonymous Rescue I
missions.description: Makarov requested the commander to assist her in infiltrating Sangvis territory to rescue the trapped Nagant M1895.

missions.title: Anonymous Rescue II
missions.description: Despite Makarov's misgivings toward her aids, the operation has been going smoothly so far.

missions.title: Anonymous Rescue III
missions.description: We rescued Nagant M1895, but Makarov's squad ran into danger. I hope her escape plan wouldn't be too outrageous...

missions.title: Anonymous Rescue IV
missions.description: Mission accomplished. We have recovered the important item in Nagant M1895's hands. Hopefully it'll prove useful to subsequent operations, otherwise...
